title: atalaya papuana
intro: Atalaya papuana, commonly known as Papuan Atalaya or Papuan Tree, is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae. It is used in traditional medicine in Papua New Guinea due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it effective in treating wounds, infections, and other health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Atalaya papuana include its ability to stimulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, contributing to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Atalaya papuana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
